T1.name: T1 Trend (EMA+ADX)
T1.explainer: T1 Trend uses a dual EMA crossover (fast 21 / slow 55) confirmed by ADX > 22. It enters long when fast EMA crosses above slow EMA in a trending market, and short when fast crosses below. Exits via ATR-based trailing stops or time limit (60 bars).

M1.name: M1 Mean-Rev (BB+RSI)
M1.explainer: M1 Mean-Reversion buys when price drops below the lower Bollinger Band and RSI < 30 (oversold). It sells short when price breaks above the upper BB and RSI > 70 (overbought). Targets the BB midline for profit; exits via ATR stop or 10-bar time limit.

H1.name: H1 Squeeze Breakout
H1.explainer: H1 Squeeze detects when Bollinger Bands compress inside Keltner Channels (volatility squeeze). When the squeeze 'fires' (BB expands outside KC after 6+ bars), it enters in the direction of the linear regression slope. Wide trailing stops give breakouts room to run.

H2.name: H2 Adaptive Blend
H2.explainer: H2 Adaptive Blend is the main strategy. It classifies the market into regimes (Bull/Bear/Range/Transition) using ADX + VATS + EMA alignment, then activates: T1 (trend-following) in trends, M1 (mean-reversion) in ranges, H1 (squeeze breakout) anywhere. Priority: H1 > T1 > M1. Improved v2: relaxed regime thresholds (ADX 20, VATS 1.2, persist 2) so T1 fires more often.

RSI.name: RSI Momentum
RSI.explainer: RSI Momentum buys when RSI crosses back above 30 (leaving oversold territory) and sells short when RSI drops below 70 (leaving overbought). Exits on opposite RSI extreme, ATR trailing stop, or 30-bar time limit.

MACD.name: MACD Crossover
MACD.explainer: MACD Crossover enters long when the MACD line (12-EMA minus 26-EMA) crosses above the 9-period signal line, and short on the opposite crossover. Exits via ATR trailing stop, signal reversal, or 60-bar time limit.

SMA.name: SMA Crossover
SMA.explainer: SMA Crossover uses the classic Golden Cross / Death Cross pattern. Enters long when SMA 50 crosses above SMA 200, short on the reverse. Exits via ATR trailing stop or signal reversal. Very few trades but captures major trends.

BH.name: Buy & Hold
BH.explainer: Buy & Hold simply buys at the start and holds until the end. Used as a benchmark.
